latestVersion.changelog:
YouTube Video Caption Generator — Initial Release

- Instantly add English and Spanish captions to your YouTube videos by simply describing your needs.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM uploads up to 500MB.
- Fully automated: video captioning and cloud rendering in 30–90 seconds.
- Free to try: get 100 credits valid for 7 days with anonymous access (no account required).
- Streamlined export to captioned 1080p MP4, with an intuitive upload–edit–download workflow.
